Lot description: ZAITRA requests proposals from space infrastructure providers (Satellite as a Service providers) to host the SKAISEN edge computing software on-board a spacecraft for about 15-month operational validation. The objective is to validate the end-to-end service (from sensor acquisition to real-time insights delivered to the end user) across multiple user-provided Areas of Interest (AoIs). SKAISEN requires access to an optical camera with ≤ 2 m GSD at 500km (2 meter or better). Multispectral bands are desirable but optional. ZAITRA žádá poskytovatele vesmírné infrastruktury (poskytovatele satelitů jako služby) o předložení nabídek na hostování softwaru SKAISEN edge computing na palubě kosmické lodi po dobu přibližně 15 měsíců. Cílem je ověřit komplexní službu (od snímání dat ze senzorů až po informace v reálném čase poskytované koncovému uživateli) napříč několika uživatelsky dostupnými oblastmi zájmu (AoI). To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

Title: Denmark – Meteorology services – Satellite imagery for in-shore ice analysis in Greenland
Procedure title: Satellite imagery for in-shore ice analysis in Greenland
Description: DMI monitors and reports routinely on sea ice and iceberg conditions near shore and inshore in South Greenland for direct support and guidance of local shipping. The suite of local ships ranges from com-mercial, passenger and coast guard ships to small individual and sail boats. The occurrence of sea ice and icebergs is a hazard or obstacle to local shipping. It has been procedure for years to notify local shipping about difficult ice before they actually enter such areas so appropriate bridge decisions can made. The primary area of interest is within 59°45’N-62°00N and 42°50’W-48°30’W. The standard products based on the helicopter recce are the following: - Ice report in plain language - Photo series of ice conditions at selected or critical positions or annotated satellite imagery. Most often .jpg files with symbols and explanations of ice conditions. - Direct ice advisory to ships via HF radio Satellite data recorded in visual wavelength in resolutions of 15-20 m or better are very valuable for the inshore mapping program however fog, cloud cover and winter darkness is a significant limitation and imagery recorded with Synthetic Aperture Radar is a necessary complimentary datasource. Near real time delivery of data is critical for the inshore program however access to data within a couple of hours turned out to be acceptable.

Udbuddet er opdelt i følgende delaftaler: • Entreprise 1: Grødeskæring med hånd/manuel i ca.245 km vandløb, • Entreprise 2: Grødeskæring med mejekurv i ca. 104 km vandløb, • Entreprise 3: Grødeskæring med grødeskærebåd og amfibiebåd, samt bortskaffelse af grøde i ca. 39 km vandløb, • Entreprise 4: Oprensning af 35 stk. sandfang og bortkørsel, samt udspredning af sandet i Ikast Brande Kommune • Entreprise 5: GPS-oprensning af ca. 50 timer i vandløb Det er muligt at byde på og få tildelt en eller flere af de udbudte delaftaler.
Lot description: • Entreprise 1: Grødeskæring med hånd/manuel i ca.245 km vandløb. Kontrakten blev tildelt til: HedeDanmarks A/S Klostermarken 12 8800 Viborg CVR-nr. 27623549 • Entreprise 2: Grødeskæring med mejekurv i ca. 104 km vandløb. Kontrakten blev tildelt: HedeDanmarks A/S Klostermarken 12 8800 Viborg CVR-nr. 27623549 Entreprise 3: Grødeskæring med grødeskærebåd og amfibiebåd, samt bortskaffelse af grøde i ca. 39 km vandløb. Kontrakten blev tildelt: Aftalen tildeles den tilbudsgiver, der afgiver det økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud på grundlag af det bedste forhold mellem pris og kvalitet, som vurderet på baggrund af nedenstående underkriterier: Pris 70 % Åmandskurser/vandløbsteknikerkurser: 30 % Entreprise 4: Oprensning af 35 stk. sandfang og bortkørsel, samt udspredning af sandet i Ikast Brande Kommune. Kontrakten blev tildelt: Skærlund Maskinstation Blå høj Kirkevej 32 7330 Brande CVR-nr. 17568388 Entreprise 5: GPS-oprensning af ca. 50 timer i vandløb. Kontrakten blev tildelt: HedeDanmarks A/S Klostermarken 12 8800 Viborg CVR-nr. 27623549

is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Title: Denmark – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Autonomous floats for the ARGO program
Procedure title: Autonomous floats for the ARGO program
Description: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

Title: Denmark – Geological and geophysical instruments – Swath scanning laser altimeter
Procedure title: Swath scanning laser altimeter
Description: DTU Space is heavily involved in ESA’s airborne satellite calibration and validation campaigns in polar regions. To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Title: Denmark – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Autonomous floats for the ARGO program
Procedure title: Autonomous floats for the ARGO program
Description: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

description: DTU Space is heavily involved in ESA’s airborne satellite calibration and validation campaigns in polar regions. To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

Title: Denmark – Geological and geophysical instruments – Swath scanning laser altimeter
Procedure title: Swath scanning laser altimeter
Description: DTU Space is heavily involved in ESA’s airborne satellite calibration and validation campaigns in polar regions. To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

Title: Denmark – Data services – Hearing on tender material - Vejdirektoratet's upcoming tender for FCD Point Data and FCD Segment Data
Procedure title: Hearing on tender material - Vejdirektoratet's upcoming tender for FCD Point Data and FCD Segment Data
Description: The Danish Road Directorate (Vejdirektoratet) conducts a hearing of the tender material for future tender for FCD Point Data and FCD Segment Data for statistical use as a basis for future analysis of traffic conditions e.g. for decision-making and planning. This requires delivery of FCD Segment Data covering all state roads in Denmark as well as municipal roads connected to the state road network and major ramp connections. The FCD is to be used primarily with several existing software systems for traffic analysis and planning purposes. Currently the The Danish Road Directorate expects the upcoming procurement will have the following deliveries: • Raw time stamped GPS/GNSS point data. • Aggregated vehicle speeds distributed over a segment road network, where speeds are based on map-matched GPS/GNSS data

description: Banedanmark har et GPS-trackingsystem, der anvendes til dels at effektivisere processer omkring lokalisering af rullende jernbanemateriel, tjenestebiler samt andet materiel og samtidig optimere dannelse af kørebogsdata for tjenestebiler og driftstimeregnskab/logbog for motoriseret rullende jernbanemateriel. Derudover er systemet brugt til at nedbringe uautoriseret og uanmeldt anvendelse af Banedanmarks materiel. Banedanmarks nuværende kontrakt på GPS-trackingsystem udløber snart, hvorfor Banedanmark med dette udbud på ny ønsker at indkøbe et GPS-trackingsystem til at understøtte samme formål som i dag samt implementering, drift, vedligehold, support, tilpasning/udvikling af det udbudte samt rådgivning. Herudover skal udstyret udskiftes, så Banedanmark ønsker at indkøbe nyt tilhørende udstyr (GPS’er) til alt materiellet. Systemet skal kunne understøtte anvendelsen af forskellige typer materiel (”rullende jernbanemateriel”, ”tjenestebiler” og ”andet materiel”), og materiellet skal være udstyret med mobile enheder (bestående af en GPS-enhed, batteri og ID-kort), der løbende via GSM-nettet sender besked til det centrale GPS-trackingsystem. Det centrale system skal leveres med en rapporteringsløsning, en administrationsgrænseflade, en grafisk grænseflade, der kan vise materiellets position på et kort samt en grænseflade rettet mod teknikere, der anvender en mobil enhed. Leverandøren skal levere udstyret til Banedanmark. Leverandøren skal forestå installation af GPS’er i tjenestebilerne i Banedanmarks bilpark, der er på over 100 biler. Banedanmark forestår selv installation af udstyret i Banedanmarks rullende materiel og øvrige materiel. Der henvises i øvrigt til udbudsmaterialet, herunder især Bilag 2 Kravspecifikation for yderligere information om de af udbuddet omfattede opgaver. Kontrakten løber fra underskrift og 4 år frem. Der henvises til kontraktens § 34. Kontrakten kan forlænges i 2 x 2 år. Kontraktens værdi er estimeret til 8 mio. kr. for 8 år (4 år + 2 år + 2 år).

Title: Denmark – Meteorology services – Satellite imagery for in-shore ice analysis in Greenland
Procedure title: Satellite imagery for in-shore ice analysis in Greenland
Description: DMI monitors and reports routinely on sea ice and iceberg conditions near shore and inshore in South Greenland for direct support and guidance of local shipping. The suite of local ships ranges from com-mercial, passenger and coast guard ships to small individual and sail boats. The occurrence of sea ice and icebergs is a hazard or obstacle to local shipping. It has been procedure for years to notify local shipping about difficult ice before they actually enter such areas so appropriate bridge decisions can made. The primary area of interest is within 59°45’N-62°00N and 42°50’W-48°30’W. The standard products based on the helicopter recce are the following: - Ice report in plain language - Photo series of ice conditions at selected or critical positions or annotated satellite imagery. Most often .jpg files with symbols and explanations of ice conditions. - Direct ice advisory to ships via HF radio Satellite data recorded in visual wavelength in resolutions of 15-20 m or better are very valuable for the inshore mapping program however fog, cloud cover and winter darkness is a significant limitation and imagery recorded with Synthetic Aperture Radar is a necessary complimentary datasource. Near real time delivery of data is critical for the inshore program however access to data within a couple of hours turned out to be acceptable.

Procedure title: Rammeaftale vedrørende levering af sporingssystem og tilhørende sporingsenheder til Aalborg Kommunes plejehjem
Description: Aalborg Kommune udbød ved udbudsbekendtgørelse nr. 2023/S 132-419489 en rammeaftale på levering af sporingssystem og tilhørende sporingsenheder til plejehjem i Aalborg Kommune. Leverandøren skal under rammeaftalen levere et web- og app-baseret sporings- og administrationssystem til Aalborg Kommune samt tilhørende sporingsenheder til visiterede borgere i kommunen. Rammeaftalen indeholder endvidere løbende support og vedligeholdelse i relation til det leverede sporingssystem. Rammeaftalen blev udbudt i to modeller med sideordnede bud, hvorved der kunne bydes på levering af sporingssystemet og de tilhørende sporingsenheder ved en købs- og/eller en leasing-model (ift. sporingsenheder og tilhørende hardware mv).

Description: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- & Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) planlægger at udbyde en rammeaftale som skal dække Forsvarets behov for civile GPS på fire år. Aftalen vil bl.a. indeholde GPS til personvogne, lastvogne (indvendig montering) og Motorcykel, som også kan anvendes til PMV, ATV, snescootere og hundeslæde (udvendig montering). Derudover vil der også være behov for håndholdte GPS m/u nødsender funktion, håndledsbårne GPS og GPS til træning og håndtering af hunde. Der forventes at være behov for standardtilbehør såsom antenner, holdere, strømforsyninger m.v. FMI ønsker at få et dybdegående kendskab til markedet for civile GPS, for at kunne planlægge et kommende udbud bedst muligt.

Procedure title: Civil GPS til Forsvaret
Description: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- & Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) planlægger at udbyde en rammeaftale som skal dække Forsvarets behov for civile GPS på fire år. Aftalen vil bl.a. indeholde GPS til personvogne, lastvogne (indvendig montering) og Motorcykel, som også kan anvendes til PMV, ATV, snescootere og hundeslæde (udvendig montering). Derudover vil der også være behov for håndholdte GPS m/u nødsender funktion, håndledsbårne GPS og GPS til træning og håndtering af hunde. Der forventes at være behov for standardtilbehør såsom antenner, holdere, strømforsyninger m.v. FMI ønsker at få et dybdegående kendskab til markedet for civile GPS, for at kunne planlægge et kommende udbud bedst muligt.

Title: Denmark – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Autonomous floats for the ARGO program
Procedure title: Autonomous floats for the ARGO program
Description: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

The metro system operates 24/7 with a varying headway throughout the day. Currently, the metro has approximately 2 million passengers per week on average. This figure is expected to increase in the coming years. The metro is a fully automated and driverless, GoA4 system, it consists of two separated systems; M1/M2 and M3/M4 each with own control and maintenance centre and is operated without any operator staff (e.g. stewards) on the trains. The assets, which are owned by Metroselskabet and are made available to the operator, include e.g. • Tunnels and structures, including stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts, bridges and embankments • Railway infrastructure, including power supply, traction power, permanent way, ATC system, platform screen doors, automatic platform gates, passenger security and information systems, SCADA, access control systems and intrusion detection systems, radio communication systems and transmission systems, passenger-counting system, and the equipment related to the Rejsekort (travel card) system and ticketing system • Electrical and mechanical installations and equipment in tunnels, structures, stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts and CMC, including ventilation • Passenger vehicles and service vehicles • Escalators • Control and Maintenance Center, including outdoor areas • Documentation, manuals and procedures • IT systems and programmes forming part of the metro system • Certain management systems • Movables • Consumables (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) • Spare parts (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) The winning tenderer (the O&M Provider) is expected to be entrusted with the full responsibility for the daily operation and the majority of the maintenance of assets forming part of the metro system, including provision of spare parts and consumables. The O&M Provider’s services, tasks, etc. under the O&M contract are, on an overall level, expected to include, but not be limited to: - Traffic operations, including operation of traffic systems and staffing. - Passenger services, e.g. traffic information and customer service. - Maintenance of assets, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, provision of spare parts, cleaning, maintenance optimisation, etc. - Information technology services, including cyber security. - Data management. - Ticketing and passenger counting. - Communication and marketing, via e.g. websites, based on communication plans and strategies. - Organisation and management services, e.g. quality management, configuration management, obsolescence management, environmental management, security and resilience management, railway safety management and human resource management. - Reporting, planning, documentation, etc., including e.g. delivery of various reports at certain intervals, provision of other information, and compilation, updating and maintenance of documentation. - Services in the mobilisation phase and in connection with the expiry of the O&M contract, including certain transitional services to assist in the mobilisation of a potential new O&M Provider. In addition, the O&M Provider is expected to perform additional tasks and projects in relation to the metro system, e.g. development / improvement of assets, on an optional basis. Furthermore, the O&M Provider is expected to participate in and provide services / deliverables in relation to a number of larger investment / reinvestment projects and other third-party projects in relation to the metro system during the O&M contract period that are expected to be subject to separate procurements / contracts. These projects are expected to include replacement of rolling stock and signalling for the M1 and M2 lines. The contract length is expected to be 12 years with one or more options for extension for a total of 3 years. Payment under the contract is expected to be in the form of operation and maintenance fees (with the addition or deduction of incentive amounts) and e.g. payments for options and variations. Metroselskabet will retain all ticket revenues. The specific scope and terms of the O&M contract may be subject to changes prior to announcement of the tender and during the tender phase based on Metroselskabet’s further assessment and the description: Metroselskabet I/S (“Metroselskabet”) intends to tender out the future operation and maintenance of the metro lines M1, M2, M3 and M4 (the “O&M contract”). The tender is expected to commence in June 2025 with operation under the O&M contract expected to start September 2027. See section 2.1.4 for further information concerning the tender procedure. Metroselskabet is currently conducting a dialogue with the market in order to gather input of relevance for the upcoming tender. Any further market operators that would like to participate in the dialogue / provide such input are encouraged to express their interest to Metroselskabet via e-mail to the contact person referred to in section 8.1. Input may be provided in writing, and Metroselskabet may invite market operators to meeting(s) to obtain further insight of relevance for the tender. The O&M contract is further described in section 5.1.
lotDescription: The O&M contract is expected to include the following services etc. and have the following characteristics: The lines encompassed by the tender span over 44 stations (30 underground stations and 14 above ground stations) and approximately 40 kilometers doubletrack in the Copenhagen area. The metro system operates 24/7 with a varying headway throughout the day. Currently, the metro has approximately 2 million passengers per week on average. This figure is expected to increase in the coming years. The metro is a fully automated and driverless, GoA4 system, it consists of two separated systems; M1/M2 and M3/M4 each with own control and maintenance centre and is operated without any operator staff (e.g. stewards) on the trains. The assets, which are owned by Metroselskabet and are made available to the operator, include e.g. • Tunnels and structures, including stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts, bridges and embankments • Railway infrastructure, including power supply, traction power, permanent way, ATC system, platform screen doors, automatic platform gates, passenger security and information systems, SCADA, access control systems and intrusion detection systems, radio communication systems and transmission systems, passenger-counting system, and the equipment related to the Rejsekort (travel card) system and ticketing system • Electrical and mechanical installations and equipment in tunnels, structures, stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts and CMC, including ventilation • Passenger vehicles and service vehicles • Escalators • Control and Maintenance Center, including outdoor areas • Documentation, manuals and procedures • IT systems and programmes forming part of the metro system • Certain management systems • Movables • Consumables (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) • Spare parts (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) The winning tenderer (the O&M Provider) is expected to be entrusted with the full responsibility for the daily operation and the majority of the maintenance of assets forming part of the metro system, including provision of spare parts and consumables. The O&M Provider’s services, tasks, etc. under the O&M contract are, on an overall level, expected to include, but not be limited to: - Traffic operations, including operation of traffic systems and staffing. - Passenger services, e.g. traffic information and customer service. - Maintenance of assets, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, provision of spare parts, cleaning, maintenance optimisation, etc. - Information technology services, including cyber security. - Data management. - Ticketing and passenger counting. - Communication and marketing, via e.g. websites, based on communication plans and strategies. - Organisation and management services, e.g. quality management, configuration management, obsolescence management, environmental management, security and resilience management, railway safety management and human resource management. - Reporting, planning, documentation, etc., including e.g. delivery of various reports at certain intervals, provision of other information, and compilation, updating and maintenance of documentation. - Services in the mobilisation phase and in connection with the expiry of the O&M contract, including certain transitional services to assist in the mobilisation of a potential new O&M Provider. In addition, the O&M Provider is expected to perform additional tasks and projects in relation to the metro system, e.g. development / improvement of assets, on an optional basis. Furthermore, the O&M Provider is expected to participate in and provide services / deliverables in relation to a number of larger investment / reinvestment projects and other third-party projects in relation to the metro system during the O&M contract period that are expected to be subject to separate procurements / contracts. These projects are expected to include replacement of rolling stock and signalling for the M1 and M2 lines. The contract length is expected to be 12 years with one or more options for extension for a total of 3 years. Payment under the contract is expected to be in the form of operation and maintenance fees (with the addition or deduction of incentive amounts) and e.g. payments for options and variations. Metroselskabet will retain all ticket revenues. The specific scope and terms of the O&M contract may be subject to changes prior to announcement of the tender and during the tender phase based on Metroselskabet’s further assessment and the potential market input to the tender.

Procedure title: Høring om elementer i påtænkt offentligt udbud af kontrakt om system til opmåling af træ i skov
Description: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Miljøministeriet, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stakke- og stokeffekter ved skovveje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data som gør, at rundtræs-takke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift). Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen skal danne grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.

Title: Denmark – Satellite-related communications equipment – Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM
Procedure title: Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM
Description: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is executing a tender of High bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM to be used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.

Complete PCR monitoring of guinea pig colonies will be performed occasionally. This will be an important contribution to the university’s general focus on a reduction of animal usage in research and education

Title: Denmark – Other services – Rodent Health Monitoring Service
Procedure title: Rodent Health Monitoring Service
Description: University of Copenhagen, Department of Experimental Medicine (AEM) calls for tender on the department’s Rodent Health Monitoring Program. Currently, AEM holds 67 dirty bedding mice sentinel cages, 3 dirty bedding rat sentinel cages, and 5 dirty bedding contact medias for mice and 4 dirty bedding contact medias for rats. Complete PCR monitoring of guinea pig colonies will be performed occasionally. Monitoring is performed in accordance with the species specific FELASA recommendations, currently Laboratory Animals 2014, Vol. 48(3) 178-192. In addition, samples after embryo transfers and samples for sick and deceased animals will be analysed. Number of samples can vary depending on research activity. AEM is intending to renew its health monitoring strategy and wishes to introduce animal free health monitoring e.g. by dirty bedding contact media, environmental monitoring, or air filter monitoring, in order to contribute to a reduction in animal usage. This will be an important contribution to the university’s general focus on a reduction of animal usage in research and education

Complete PCR monitoring of guinea pig colonies will be performed occasionally. Monitoring is performed in accordance with the species specific FELASA recommendations, currently Laboratory Animals 2014, Vol. 48(3) 178-192. In addition, samples after embryo transfers and samples for sick and deceased animals will be analysed. Number of samples can vary depending on research activity. AEM is intending to renew its health monitoring strategy and wishes to introduce animal free health monitoring e.g. by dirty bedding contact media, environmental monitoring, or air filter monitoring, in order to contribute to a reduction in animal usage. This will be an important contribution to the university’s general focus on a reduction of animal usage in research and education

er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. description: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen danner grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.

Description: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Otrkārt, uzdevums saistībā ar lietotāju iesaistes pasākumiem, piemēram, palīdzība ad hoc sanāksmēm, atbalsts produktu izplatīšanai un apmācību organizēšanai.","hun":"A tárgy szolgáltatási keretszerződés megkötése egy gazdasági szereplővel, melynek feladata nagy felbontású átjárhatatlan rétegek gyártása és aktualizálása a nem növényzettel borított, új nagy felbontású rétegek talajlefedettségi jellemzőinek keretein belül. A termékeknek folytonosságot kell biztosítaniuk a már meglévő termékekhez, azaz az átjárhatatlansági réteghez és az abból származó termékekhez, valamint a beépített területhez kapcsolódó réteghez, valamint olyan új termékek létrehozásához, amelyek információt nyújtanak a beépített területek változásáról és az állandóan fedetlen talajról és kőzetről. A gyártási feladatokon kívül a pályázati felhívás két tanácsadói feladatot is tartalmaz. Először is, a globális emberi települési réteggel való harmonizáció feladatát jelenleg az Európai Bizottság Közös Kutatóközpontja (JRC) látja el azzal a céllal, hogy szükség esetén biztosítsa a globális és a páneurópai termékek közötti koherenciát. Másodszor, a felhasználói tevékenységekhez kapcsolódó feladat, mint például eseti találkozókhoz biztosított segítségnyújtás, a termékek terjesztésének támogatása és képzések szervezése.","gle":"Is é an t-ábhar creatchonradh seirbhíse a chur ar bun le hoibreoir eacnamaíoch lena gclúdófar neamh-thréscaoilteacht shraith ardtaifigh (HRL) faoi chreat na saintréithe sraithe ardtaifigh nua um chumhdach talún neamhfhásmhair a tháirgeadh agus a nuashonrú. Ar an dara dul síos, cúram i ndáil le gníomhaíochtaí glactha ag úsáideoirí, amhail cúnamh le cruinnithe ad hoc, tacú le scaipeadh táirgí, agus eagrú oiliúintí.","ell":"Το αντικείμενο είναι η σύναψη μιας σύμβασης-πλαισίου υπηρεσιών με έναν οικονομικό φορέα που θα καλύπτει την παραγωγή και την ενημέρωση της αδιαπερατότητας του επιπέδου υψηλής λύσης (HRL — High-Resolution Layer) στο πλαίσιο των νέων χαρακτηριστικών κάλυψης του εδάφους χωρίς βλάστηση HRL. Τα προϊόντα πρέπει να παρέχουν συνέχεια στα ήδη υπάρχοντα προϊόντα, δηλαδή αδιαπερατότητα και τα παράγωγα προϊόντα της, και δομημένη επιφάνεια, και δημιουργία νέων προϊόντων που παρέχουν πληροφορίες σχετικά με τις αλλαγές της δομημένης επιφάνειας και τα μόνιμα ακάλυπτα εδάφη και πετρώματα. Εκτός από τα καθήκοντα παραγωγής, στην πρόσκληση υποβολής προσφορών περιλαμβάνονται δύο καθήκοντα παροχής συμβουλών. Πρώτον, ένα καθήκον εναρμόνισης με το παγκόσμιο επίπεδο ανθρώπινων οικισμών που εκπονείται επί του παρόντος από το Κοινό Κέντρο Ερευνών της Ευρωπαϊκής Επιτροπής (JRC) με σκοπό τη διασφάλιση της συνοχής μεταξύ των παγκόσμιων και πανευρωπαϊκών προϊόντων, εάν χρειαστεί. tedRawJSONPart02: εύτερον, ένα καθήκον που σχετίζεται με δραστηριότητες αποδοχής από τους χρήστες, όπως παροχή βοήθειας σε ad-hoc συναντήσεις, υποστήριξη στη διάδοση προϊόντων και οργάνωση προγραμμάτων κατάρτισης.","spa":"El objeto es el establecimiento de un contrato marco de servicios con un operador económico que cubra la producción y actualización de la impermeabilidad de la capa de alta resolución en el marco de las nuevas características de la cubierta terrestre sin vegetación de la capa de alta resolución. Los productos darán continuidad a los ya existentes, es decir, la impermeabilidad y sus productos derivados, y a la superficie construida, así como a la creación de nuevos productos que proporcionen información sobre el cambio de superficie construida y los suelos y rocas descubiertas permanentes. Aparte de las tareas de producción, en la convocatoria de licitación se incluyen dos tareas de consultoría. En primer lugar, una tarea de armonización con la Capa Global de Asentamientos Humanos que actualmente está produciendo el Centro Común de Investigación de la Comisión Europea (JRC) con el fin de garantizar la coherencia entre los productos globales y paneuropeos, en caso necesario. En segundo lugar, una tarea relacionada con las actividades de asimilación de los usuarios, como la asistencia a reuniones ad hoc, el apoyo a la difusión de productos y la organización de formaciones.","est":"Eesmärk on sõlmida ettevõtjaga teenuste raamleping, mis hõlmab läbistamatuse HRLi tootmist ja ajakohastamist taimestikuta maakatte omaduste uue HRLi raamistikus. Tooted peavad tagama järjepidevuse juba olemasolevate toodete (st läbistamatuse ja sellest tuletatud toodete) ning hoonestatud ala toodetega ning uute toodete loomise, mis annavad teavet hoonestatud ala muutuste ning püsikatteta muld- ja kivipinnase kohta. Pakkumiskutse hõlmab lisaks tootmistegevusele ka kahte nõustamisülesannet. Neist esimene hõlmab ühtlustamist Euroopa Komisjoni Teadusuuringute Ühiskeskuse (JRC) poolt praegu koostamisel oleva ülemaailmse inimasustuse kihiga, et tagada vajaduse korral ülemaailmsete ja üleeuroopaliste toodete vaheline sidusus. Teine ülesanne on seotud kasutajate kaasamise tegevustega, näiteks abi vajaduspõhisel kohtumistel, toodete levitamise toetamine ja koolituste korraldamine.","nld":"Het voorwerp is het sluiten van een raamovereenkomst voor diensten met een ondernemer voor de productie en actualisering van de ondoordringbaarheid van de hogeresolutielaag (HRL) in het kader van de kenmerken van de nieuwe HRL van niet-geplante bodembedekking. De producten moeten continuïteit bieden aan de reeds bestaande producten, d.w.z. ondoordringbaarheid en afgeleide producten, alsook bebouwde gebieden, en daarnaast moeten nieuwe producten worden gecreëerd die informatie opleveren over de veranderingen in bebouwde gebieden en over permanent onbegroeide gronden en rotsen. Naast de productietaken omvat de oproep tot inschrijving twee adviestaken. Ten eerste een taak inzake harmonisatie met de laag van wereldwijde menselijke vestiging die momenteel wordt geproduceerd door het Gemeenschappelijk Centrum voor onderzoek van de Europese Commissie (JRC) om de samenhang tussen de mondiale en de pan-Europese producten indien nodig te verzekeren. Ten tweede een taak die verband houdt met activiteiten om het inzicht van gebruikers te vergroten, zoals bijstand bij ad-hocvergaderingen, ondersteuning bij de verspreiding van producten en de organisatie van opleidingen.","fin":"Tämän tarjouspyynnön kohteena on sellaisen palveluja koskevan puitesopimuksen tekeminen talouden toimijan kanssa, joka kattaa läpäisemättömyyttä koskevan suuren tarkkuuden kerrosten (High-Resolution Layer — HRL) tuotannon ja päivityksen kasvittoman maanpeitteen ominaisuuksia koskevan uuden suuren tarkkuuden kerroksen yhteydessä. Tuotteilla on jatkettava jo olemassa olevia tuotteita, jotka koskevat läpäisemättömyyttä ja siitä johdettuja tuotteita, sekä rakennettua aluetta sekä sellaisten uusien tuotteiden luomista, jotka antavat tietoa rakennetun alueen muutoksesta ja pysyvästä paljaasta maasta ja kalliosta. Tuotantotehtävien lisäksi tarjouspyyntöön sisältyy kaksi konsultointitehtävää. Ensimmäinen tehtävä on Euroopan komission yhteisen tutkimuskeskuksen (JRC) parhaillaan tuottaman maailmanlaajuisen asutuksen kerroksen yhdenmukaistaminen, jolla pyritään varmistamaan tarvittaessa maailmanlaajuisten ja yleiseurooppalaisten tuotteiden välinen yhdenmukaisuus. Toinen tehtävä koskee käyttöönottoa käyttäjien keskuudessa koskevia toimia, kuten satunnaisia kokouksia, tuotteiden levittämisen tukemista ja koulutusten järjestämistä.","pol":"Przedmiotem zamówienia jest zawarcie umowy ramowej o usługi z podmiotem gospodarczym, obejmującej produkcję i aktualizację warstwy pokrycia terenu o wysokiej rozdzielczości (HRL) w zakresie terenu nieporośniętego roślinnością Produkty powinny zapewniać ciągłość już istniejących produktów, tj. obszarów nieprzepuszczalnych i ich produktów pochodnych oraz obszaru budowy, a także tworzenie nowych produktów, które dostarczają informacji o zabudowie terenu oraz glebach i skałach. Oprócz zadań produkcyjnych zaproszenie do składania ofert obejmuje 2 zadania z zakresu doradztwa. Po pierwsze, zadanie dotyczące harmonizacji z globalną warstwą osiedli ludzkich, która jest obecnie przygotowywana przez Wspólne Centrum Badawcze Komisji Europejskiej (JRC) w celu zapewnienia spójności między globalnymi i paneuropejskimi produktami w razie potrzeby. Po drugie, zadanie związane z działaniami polegającymi na korzystaniu przez użytkowników, takie jak pomoc w spotkaniach ad hoc, wsparcie w rozpowszechnianiu produktów i organizacja szkoleń.","hrv":"Predmet je sklapanje okvirnog ugovora o pružanju usluga s gospodarskim subjektom koji obuhvaća proizvodnju i ažuriranje nepropusnosti sloja visoke rezolucije (High Resolution Layer — HRL) u okviru novih HRL obilježja stanja kopna koje nije pokriveno vegetacijom. Proizvodi moraju obezbjediti kontinuitet na već postojećim proizvodima, odnosno nepropusnosti i na njoj izvedenim proizvodima, te stvaranje novih proizvoda koji daju informacije o promjenama na izgrađenom području te trajnom tlu bez vegetacije i kamenu. Osim zadataka proizvodnje, u poziv na nadmetanje uključena su dva savjetodavna zadatka. Prvo, zadatak usklađivanja s globalnim modelom za ljudska naselja koji trenutačno proizvodi Zajednički istraživački centar Europske komisije (JRC) s ciljem osiguranja usklađenosti globalnih i paneuropskih proizvoda po potrebi. Drugo, zadatak povezan s aktivnostima usvajanja korisnika, kao što je pomoć ad-hoc sastancima, podrška širenju proizvoda i organizacija osposobljavanja.","ces":"Předmětem je uzavření rámcové smlouvy o poskytování služeb s hospodářským subjektem, která bude zahrnovat výrobu a aktualizaci nepropustnosti vrstvy s vysokým rozlišením (HRL) v rámci nových vlastností půdy nepokryté vegetací HLR. Produkty musí zajišťovat kontinuitu již existujících produktů, tj. nepropustnosti a produktů z nich získaných, zastavené plochy a musí vytvářet nové produkty, které poskytují informace o změně zastavěné plochy a trvalých půdách a horninách. Kromě úkolů v oblasti tvorby jsou ve výzvě k podávání nabídek zahrnuty dva úkoly týkající se poradenství. Za prvé, úkol týkající se harmonizace s globální vrstvou lidských sídel, kterou v současné době vytváří Společné výzkumné středisko Evropské komise (JRC), s cílem zajistit v případě potřeby soudržnost mezi globálními a celoevropskými produkty. Za druhé, úkol týkající se činností uživatelského využití, jako je pomoc při ad-hoc jednáních, podpora šíření produktů a organizace školení.","dan":"Genstanden er indgåelse af en rammetjenesteydelseskontrakt med en økonomisk aktør, der omfatter produktion og opdatering af uigennemtrængeligheden i højopløsningslaget (HRL — High-Resolution Layer) inden for rammerne af de nye HRL-karakteristika for ikke-vegetativt arealdække. Produkterne skal give kontinuitet i forhold til de allerede eksisterende produkter, dvs. uigennemtrængelighed og deraf afledte produkter og bebyggede områder, samt skabe nye produkter, der giver oplysninger om ændringer i bebyggede områder og permanent bare jordarealer og klipper. Der er ud over produktionsopgaverne inkluderet to rådgivningsopgaver i udbuddet. For det første en opgave med hensyn til harmonisering med laget for globale bosættelses- og bebyggelsesmiljøer, som i øjeblikket udarbejdes af Europa-Kommissionens Fælles Forskningscenter (JRC), med henblik på at sikre sammenhæng mellem de globale og de paneuropæiske produkter, hvis det er nødvendigt. For det andet en opgave vedrørende brugerudnyttelsesaktiviteter, såsom bistand til ad hoc-møder, støtte til formidling af produkter og tilrettelæggelse af undervisning.","ron":"Obiectul constă în încheierea unui contract-cadru de servicii cu un operator economic care să acopere producerea și actualizarea impermeabilității la nivelul de înaltă rezoluție (HRL) în cadrul noilor caracteristici de acoperire a terenurilor nevegetate de înaltă rezoluție (HRL). Produsele trebuie să asigure continuitatea produselor deja existente, și anume a impermeabilității și a produselor derivate, precum și a suprafeței construite și crearea de noi produse care oferă informații privind schimbarea suprafeței construite și solurile și rocile goale permanente. În afară de sarcinile de producție, în licitație sunt incluse două sarcini de consultanță. În primul rând, o sarcină de armonizare cu nivelul global de așezări umane produs în prezent de Centrul Comun de Cercetare al Comisiei Europene (JRC), în vederea asigurării coerenței între produsele globale și cele paneuropene, dacă este necesar. În al doilea rând, o sarcină legată de activitățile de adoptare a utilizatorilor, cum ar fi asistență pentru reuniunile ad-hoc, susținere pentru diseminarea produselor și organizarea de cursuri de formare.","por":"O objeto consiste no estabelecimento de um contrato-quadro de serviços com um operador económico que abranja a produção e atualização da impermeabilidade da camada de alta resolução no quadro das novas características de ocupação não-vegetativa do solo da camada de alta resolução. Os produtos devem dar continuidade aos produtos já existentes, ou seja, à impermeabilidade e aos seus produtos derivados, e à área construída, e à criação de novos produtos que forneçam informações sobre as mudanças na área construída e sobre solos e rochas permanentemente nus. Para além das tarefas de produção, estão incluídas no concurso duas tarefas de consultoria. Em primeiro lugar, uma tarefa de harmonização com a camada global de povoamento humano atualmente produzida pelo Centro Comum de Investigação (JRC) da Comissão Europeia, com vista a assegurar a coerência entre os produtos globais e pan-europeus, se necessário. Em segundo lugar, uma tarefa relacionada com atividades de adoção por parte dos utilizadores, tais como assistência a reuniões ad hoc, apoio à divulgação de produtos e organização de formações.","slk":"Predmetom je uzatvorenie rámcovej zmluvy na poskytovanie služieb s hospodárskym subjektom zastrešujúcim tvorbu a aktualizáciu nepriepustných plôch vrstvy s vysokým rozlíšením v rámci novej charakteristiky nevegetačnej krajinnej pokrývky. Produkty zabezpečia kontinuitu už existujúcich produktov, t. j. nepriepustných plôch a odvodených produktov, a zastavanej oblasti a vytvorenie nových produktov, ktoré poskytnú informácie o zmene zastavanej plochy a trvalej pôde ponechanej bez porastu a horninách. Okrem úloh súvisiacich s výrobou sú súčasťou výzvy na predloženie ponúk dve konzultačné úlohy. Po prvé, úloha harmonizácie s globálnou mapovou vrstvou ľudského osídlenia, ktorú v súčasnosti vypracúva Spoločné výskumné centrum Európskej komisie (JRC), s cieľom zabezpečiť v prípade potreby súdržnosť medzi globálnymi a celoeurópskymi produktmi. Po druhé, úloha týkajúca sa činností využitia zo strany používateľov, ako je pomoc pri príležitostných stretnutiach, podpora šírenia produktov a organizácia školení.","mlt":"Is-suġġett huwa t-twaqqif ta’ qafas ta’ kuntratt ta’ servizz ma’ operatur ekonomiku li jkopri l-produzzjoni u l-aġġornament tal-impermeabbiltà tas-saff b’riżoluzzjoni għolja (HRL) fil-qafas tal-karatteristiċi l-ġodda għall-kopertura ta’ art mhux veġetata tal-HRL. Il-prodotti għandhom jagħtu kontinwità lill-prodotti diġà eżistenti, jiġifieri l-Impermeabbiltà u l-prodotti derivati minnha, u ż-Żona mibnija, u l-ħolqien ta’ prodotti ġodda li jagħtu informazzjoni dwar tibdil fiż-żona mibnija u fil-ħamrija u fil-blat għeri permanenti. Minbarra l-kompiti tal-produzzjoni, żewġ kompiti ta’ konsulenza huma inklużi fis-sejħa għall-offerti. L-ewwel, kompitu dwar l-armonizzazzjoni mas-saff ta’ postijiet fejn jgħixu n-nies globali li bħalissa qed jiġi prodott mal-Kunsill Ewropew tar-Riċerka tal-Kummissjoni Ewropea (JRC) bil-għan li tiġi żgurata l-koerenza bejn il-prodotti globali u dawk pan-Ewropej jekk meħtieġ. It-tieni, kompitu relatat mal-attivitajiet ta’ adozzjoni mill-utent, bħall-assistenza għal laqgħat ad hoc, bħall-appoġġ għat-tixrid ta’ prodotti u bħall-organizzazzjoni ta’ taħriġ.","fra":"Le présent marché porte sur l’établissement d’un marché de services cadre avec un opérateur économique couvrant la production et la mise à jour de l’imperméabilité des couches haute résolution (HRL) dans le cadre des nouvelles caractéristiques de l’occupation non-végétale des sols par des couches haute résolution. Les produits doivent assurer la continuité des produits déjà existants, c’est-à-dire l’imperméabilité et ses produits dérivés, et la surface bâtie, ainsi que la création de nouveaux produits donnant des informations sur les changements de la surface bâtie et les sols et les rochers nus permanents. Outre les tâches de production, deux tâches de conseil sont incluses dans l’appel d’offres. Premièrement, une tâche d’harmonisation avec la couche mondiale des établissements humains actuellement réalisée par le Centre commun de recherche de la Commission européenne (JRC) en vue d’assurer la cohérence entre les produits mondiaux et paneuropéens si nécessaire. Deuxièmement, une tâche liée aux activités d’adoption par les utilisateurs, telle que l’assistance à des réunions ad hoc, le soutien à la diffusion des produits et l’organisation de formations.","deu":"Gegenstand ist der Abschluss eines Dienstleistungsrahmenvertrags mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer, der die Herstellung und Aktualisierung der Imperviousness von High-Resolution Layer (HRL) im Rahmen der neuen HRL-Eigenschaften der nicht bewachsenen Landabdeckung abdeckt. Die Produkte sollen den bereits bestehenden Produkten, d. h. der Imperviousness und ihren abgeleiteten Produkten, sowie dem Aufbau von Flächen und der Schaffung neuer Produkte, die Informationen über den Bau von Flächenwechseln und dauerhaften nackten Böden und Felsen geben, Kontinuität verleihen. Neben den Produktionsaufgaben sind zwei Beratungsaufgaben in der Ausschreibung enthalten. Erstens eine Aufgabe zur Harmonisierung mit der globalen Siedlungsschicht, der derzeit von der Gemeinsamen Forschungsstelle der Europäischen Kommission (JRC) erstellt wird, um bei Bedarf die Kohärenz zwischen den globalen und den gesamteuropäischen Produkten zu gewährleisten. Zweitens, eine Aufgabe im Zusammenhang mit Nutzerakzeptanzaktivitäten, wie Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Treffen, Unterstützung bei der Verbreitung von Produkten und Organisation von Schulungen.","lit":"Tikslas – sudaryti preliminariąją paslaugų pirkimo sutartį su ekonominės veiklos vykdytoju dėl didelės skiriamosios gebos sluoksnių (HRL) neveiklumo kūrimo ir atnaujinimo naujų HRL neaugintų žemės dangos charakteristikų kontekste. Produktai turi užtikrinti jau esamų produktų, t. y. nepralaidumo ir iš jų pagamintų produktų, bei statybos teritorijos tęstinumą ir naujų produktų, suteikiančių informacijos apie užstatytos teritorijos pasikeitimą ir nuolatinį dirva bei uoliena, kūrimą. Be gamybos užduočių, į kvietimą pateikti pasiūlymus įtrauktos dvi konsultacinės užduotys. Pirma, šiuo metu Europos Komisijos Jungtinio tyrimų centro (JRC) rengiama užduotis suderinti veiksmus su Pasauliniu žmogaus socialinės padėties centru, siekiant užtikrinti, jei reikia, pasaulio ir visos Europos produktų darną. Antra, užduotis, susijusi su naudotojų įsisavinimo veikla, pvz., pagalba ad hoc susitikimams, parama produktų sklaidai ir mokymų organizavimas.","ita":"L'oggetto è la stipula di un contratto quadro di servizi con un operatore economico riguardante la produzione e l'aggiornamento dell'impermeabilità dello strato ad alta risoluzione nel quadro delle caratteristiche della copertura del suolo senza vegetazione del nuovo strato ad alta risoluzione. I prodotti devono dare continuità ai prodotti già esistenti, vale a dire l'impermeabilità e i prodotti derivati, e all'area edificata, nonché alla creazione di nuovi prodotti che forniscano informazioni sui cambiamenti dell'area edificata e sui suoli nudi e rocciosi permanenti. Oltre agli incarichi di produzione, il bando di gara include due incarichi di consulenza. In primo luogo, un incarico di armonizzazione con lo strato di insediamento umano globale attualmente in fase di produzione da parte del Centro comune di ricerca della Commissione europea (JRC), al fine di garantire la coerenza tra i prodotti globali e paneuropei, se necessario. In secondo luogo, un incarico relativo alle attività di accettazione degli utenti, come l'assistenza a riunioni ad hoc, il sostegno alla diffusione di prodotti e l'organizzazione di corsi di formazione.","bul":"Предметът е сключването на рамков договор за услуги с икономически оператор, обхващащ производството и актуализирането на слоя с висока разделителна способност (HRL) за непромокаемостта в рамките на характеристиките на новия слой с висока разделителна способност на земната покривка без растителност. Продуктите трябва да осигурят приемственост на вече съществуващите продукти, т.е. непромокаемост и нейните производни продукти и застроените зони, както и създаването на нови продукти, които дават информация за промяна на застроените зони и постоянните оголени почви и скали. Освен производствените задачи, в поканата за участие в търг са включени и две консултантски задачи. Първо, задача по хармонизиране с Глобалния слой на населените места, който се изготвя понастоящем от Съвместния изследователски център на Европейската комисия (JRC) с оглед осигуряване на съгласуваност между глобалните и паневропейските продукти, ако е необходимо. Второ, задача, свързана с дейности по поддръжка за потребителите, като например помощ за ad hoc срещи, подкрепа за разпространение на продукти и организиране на обучения.","slv":"Predmet je sklenitev okvirne pogodbe o storitvah z gospodarskim subjektom za izdelavo in posodobitev sloja visoke ločljivosti (High-Resolution Layer – HRL) o neprepustnosti v okviru novega sloja podatkov visoke ločljivosti o nevegetacijski pokrovnosti tal. Izdelki morajo zagotavljati kontinuiteto že obstoječih izdelkov, tj. izdelkov za nepropustnost in povezanih izdelkov ter izdelkov v zvezi s pozidanimi območji, in prispevati k ustvarjanju novih izdelkov, ki dajejo informacije o spremembah na pozidanih območjih ter v zvezi s trajno golimi tlemi in skalnatimi območji. Poleg proizvodnih nalog sta v javni razpis vključeni še dve svetovalni nalogi. Prvič, naloga usklajevanja s slojem globalne poseljenosti, ki ga trenutno pripravlja Skupno raziskovalno središče Evropske komisije (JRC), z namenom zagotavljanja skladnosti med globalnimi in vseevropskimi izdelki, če je to potrebno. Drugič, naloga, povezana z dejavnostmi za spodbujanje uporabe s strani uporabnikov, kot so pomoč pri ad hoc sestankih, podpora pri razširjanju izdelkov in organizacija usposabljanj.","eng":"The subject is the establishment of a framework service contract with an economic operator covering the production and update of high-resolution layer (HRL) imperviousness in the frame of the new HRL non-vegetated land cover characteristics. Products shall give continuity to the already existing products, i.e. Imperviousness and its derived products, and Built up area, and the creation of new products that give information on built up area change and permanent bare soils and rock. Apart from the production tasks two consultancy tasks are included in the call for tenders. First, a task on harmonization with the global human settlement layer currently being produced by the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission (JRC) with the view of ensuring the coherence between the global and the pan European products if needed. Second, a task related to user uptake activities, such as assistance to ad-hoc meetings, support to dissemination of products and organisation of trainings."},"buyer-identifier":["18139839"]}

The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare Title: Denmark – Satellite-related communications equipment – Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM
Procedure title: Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM
Description: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is executing a tender of High bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM to be used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.

Procedure title: Fire Control Systems (FCS) for 84 Recoilless Rifle, 12,7 mm Heavy Machine Gun and 40 mm Automatic Granate Launcher
Description: DALO is considering publishing a future tender for the supply and sustainment of an advanced sigthing system (also called "FCS" - Fire Control System), able to cover several weapon platforms, including 84mm recoilles rifle (hereunder CG M4), 12.7mm heavy machine guns (HMG) and 40mm automatic grenade launchers (hereunder H&K GMG). Full compatibility with the SAAB Dynamics AB Carl-Gustaf M4 system (including FIREBOLT technology) is in this case a must-have. The offered FCS must also be able to provide automated ballistic calculation functionality allowing for engaging static and moving targets with different weapons and in differnt situations (from a static position, from a vehicle/vessel/aircraft) and at the weapons' effective ranges. Due to the system's specific interaction with other systems, it is expected that the Supplier will not only be able to meet the technical requirements (mostly rooted in the desired performance across diferent use patterns), but that they will also be able to guarantee integration with systems such as indoor simulators already in use by the Danish Defence (GSIMS from Thales). Sustainment of DALO's existing legacy fleet of in-service FCS (Aimpoint FCS14 RE) may also be the part of the tender. DALO is therefore seeking information in order to prepare for the possible tender. DALO encourages all potential suppliers to show their interest by answering this Request for Information (RFI).

The Polar Connect step 1 runs for 3 years from January 2025 to December 2027 and is aimed to achieve several objectives in the areas described below. • Engagement with stakeholders interested in securing global connectivity and providing access to an innovative research instrument made of sensors along the subsea cable. • Detailed mapping of the Arctic Ocean, which starts with preparing pre-survey of the route, mission planning considering the critical weather conditions and costs, three survey missions, and the analysis of the survey data. • Technical planning and design activities, including route planning, planning of the resilience, determination of the optimal locations of potential cable landing sites and branching units, including security and access control, environmental impact, permitting and regulatory compliance, collaboration with local authorities, emergency response and repair, remote monitoring and control systems, and back-up communication systems. • Sensor technology planning, analysis of available technologies for cable sensing and their contributions for security-, integrity-, scientific- and environmental monitoring. The Polar Connect step 1 runs for 3 years from January 2025 to December 2027 and is aimed to achieve several objectives in the areas described below. • Engagement with stakeholders interested in securing global connectivity and providing access to an innovative research instrument made of sensors along the subsea cable. • Detailed mapping of the Arctic Ocean, which starts with preparing pre-survey of the route, mission planning considering the critical weather conditions and costs, three survey missions, and the analysis of the survey data. • Technical planning and design activities, including route planning, planning of the resilience, determination of the optimal locations of potential cable landing sites and branching units, including security and access control, environmental impact, permitting and regulatory compliance, collaboration with local authorities, emergency response and repair, remote monitoring and control systems, and back-up communication systems. • Sensor technology planning, analysis of available technologies for cable sensing and their contributions for security-, integrity-, scientific- and environmental monitoring. It is foreseen that there will be consultancies needed for several areas.

description: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen danner grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.

Lot description: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere.
